chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), when he went out from the house in the summer, would go out on Thursday. And when he wanted to enter [the house] in the winter from the cold, he would enter on Friday. And it is also reported that his entry and his exit was on the night of Friday.
ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's (peace be upon him) custom for entering and exiting his house in summer versus winter?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) adherence to seasonal rhythms, aligning his movements with the thermal comfort of summer and winter. The variation between Thursday, Friday, and the night of Friday reflects the scholarly understanding of flexible sunnah practices tailored to environmental conditions and communal worship cycles. This practice underscores the Islamic emphasis on balancing physical well-being with spiritual discipline within the domestic sphere.
